vocabulary.meaning: a topic studied at school or college
work given by a teacher to be done at home
to officially join a course or school
to finish school or university successfully
half of a school or university year
a talk about a topic, often in class

grammar_tips.title: Talking about past studies
grammar_tips.explanation: Use the simple past for completed studies. Example: I studied biology last year.

grammar_tips.title: Present Perfect for recent achievements
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'have/has + past participle' for recent events. Example: I have just finished my assignment.

example_sentences.sentence: I am enrolled in a degree course.
He passed his final exam last week.
She has completed all her assignments.
Our teacher gave a lecture on chemistry.
